info.summary: Training records and certificates of conduct for the leader team
Schulungsnachweise und Führungszeugnisse für die Leiterrunde
info.description:
Training module of the Leiterrunde suite – requires the Leiterrunde app.
Training and certificate management:
• Training types with validity periods, hour credits and required flags • Training records per person with certificate file upload and approve/reject workflow • Group training sessions that create records for all attendees • Certificates of conduct (Führungszeugnisse) with issue date and validity tracking • Automatic status checks and expiry reminders via background job • Per-person training status overview used across the suite
Requires the Leiterrunde app for persons, roles and permissions.
